author: Jincheng Liu
decision_rule: V4 may replace V3 only when the deployment-candidate schedule mode passes every noninferiority, worst-condition, issue-rate, and coverage gate on a batch-disjoint calibration partition. Oracle-only improvement cannot promote V4.
claim_boundary: This protocol was frozen without Hithium measurements. Public SNL outcomes and private-development diagnostics were already exposed, so they cannot independently confirm V4. A Hithium-specific claim requires separately controlled development, calibration, and one locked-test execution. No result alone establishes 15-25 year accuracy.
